text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a lightweight playbook for the snackable starterkit launch. Goals: 1) a short blog + GitHub refapp, 2) a 30-min demo webinar, 3) a tiny benchmark story for social, and 4) clear inbound routing for leads. Who can take which piece?
liam: I can own the GitHub refapp + 1-2 short howtos. ETA EOW for initial PR.
tara: I’ll draft the blog post outline and key messaging. Lean, example-driven. Target length ~600-800 words.
noah: I’ll build the benchmark narrative — 3 quick charts (latency, cost/unit, throughput) using the devkit. Need refapp artifacts from liam by Thurs.
priya: I’ll handle webinar logistics and registration flow. Suggest 2 co-hosts: liam + maya. Also need a simple slide deck (6-8 slides).
maya: Thumbs up. Priorities: make it frictionless for devs to clone + run locally, and show a measurable cost/latency win.
liam: proto repo layout: 
```
/starterkit
  /examples
  /benchmarks
  /README.md
  /docker
```
Will include a quick `curl` getting-started snippet.
priya: For inbound routing — propose: webinar registrants -> demo lead nurture sequence (3 emails) -> tag in CRM as "starterkit-interest". Who can draft the email copy?
tara: I’ll write email drafts tuned to PLG audience. Short subject lines, CTAs to GitHub and live demo.
noah: For benchmark visuals I’ll export PNGs and a short table for the blog. Also propose a 30s GIF demo for social.
devrel-bot: Reminder: set up a dedicated tracking utm campaign: utm_source=starterkit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=starterkit_launch
maya: Action items recap: liam - repo + examples (EOW). tara - blog + email drafts (Mon). noah - benchmarks + GIF (Mon). priya - webinar page + reg flow (Mon). I’ll draft the social copy and pressy snippets.
liam: One ask — can we keep the code dependency footprint tiny (<=2 libs)? helps adoption.
tara: Agreed. Messaging note: emphasize "build in 5 minutes" and "works with Redwood Dedicated/Hosted" for clarity.
priya: Scheduling — target webinar Wed next week 10am PT. If that works, I’ll create event and calendar invites.
maya: Works for me. If everyone hits their EOW/Mon milestones we can open registration Tue.
noah: I’ll mock the chart annotations so they’re narrative-ready for the blog.
liam: I’ll add a short CONTRIBUTING.md for community PRs and one-click deploy badges.
tara: Drafting blog now — will ping for review once first pass done.
priya: Putting placeholder event page now, will update once speakers + slides are in.
maya: Thanks team — small, high-impact launch. Let’s keep threads tight. :rocket:
